mapper.select: SELECT productId, prodName, brand, c.categoryId, inboundPrice, price, heelHeight, discRate, minGrade, status, TO_CHAR(regDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDate FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.categoryId = c.categoryId ORDER BY productId DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert:
SELECT product_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO product(productId, prodName, brand, categoryId, inboundPrice, price, heelHeight, discRate, minGrade, status, regDate , thumbnail) VALUES (#{productId}, #{prodName}, #{brand}, #{categoryId}, #{inboundPrice}, #{price}, #{heelHeight}, #{discRate}, #{minGrade}, #{status}, SYSDATE, #{thumbnail})
INSERT INTO productImage(imageId, productId, files, sortOrder) VALUES (PRODUCT_IMAGE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{files}, #{sortOrder})
